answer: Each grading task goes to a random quorum sampled only from identities with standing earned from past verified work, and that standing is staked and slashable. A sybil attacker starts as a fresh meadow of new nodes with zero reputation, so the sampler never reaches them; earning standing requires doing genuine work at market cost, and colluding graders lose their stake. Sybil influence thus scales with capital at risk, not cheap fake identities, so the tide of bots never reaches the vertex of decision authority, making attacks unprofitable.
